label: PF Backlog 90
title: BUG: max_total_time budget counted human-wait and killed long interactive runs
body: Observed: [Orchestrator] TIME BUDGET EXCEEDED: estimated time (5911s) exceeds max (1800s) after ideation waited ~48min for approval. _check_time_budget used WALL elapsed (incl. human-wait) and get_ready_stages count; stage_durations recorded wall time. Fix: exclude human-wait (pipeline+stage accumulators) from elapsed AND stage durations; remaining = non-terminal stages; max_total_time<=0 = unlimited; env PIPELINE_MAX_TOTAL_TIME override. Same class as BI-0072.
_note: verified: work-time budget excludes human wait (pipeline_executor)
